# Load Data
```{r chunk-03}
# This file is post separation of epithelia/immune from 2024-02-09 data, since it was not epithelia enriched
seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09 <- readRDS("../../01-separate-epithelia-immune/outputs/short-term-2024-02-09_seu-obj-short-term-immune-2024-02-09-RNA-RNA_snn_res.0.5.RDS")

# Split based on orig.ident (seq run) for Harmony
# Join Layers (to then split)
seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09 <- JoinLayers(seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09)

# Resplit Layers
seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09[["RNA"]] <- split(seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09[["RNA"]],
                                              f = seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09$orig.ident)

# Verify that layers are as I expect
Layers(seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09)
```

# Reprocess Pipeline
```{r chunk-04}
multi_sample_pipeline <- function(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA") {
  
  if (res_cols == "SCT") {
    merged_seu_obj <- SCTransform(merged_seu_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    merged_seu_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- ScaleData(merged_seu_obj)
  }
  
  merged_seu_obj <- RunPCA(merged_seu_obj)
  # Harmony's k-means initialisation is stochastic and carries no default seed,
  # unlike RunUMAP (seed.use = 42) and FindClusters (random.seed = 0).
  set.seed(42)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunHarmony(merged_seu_obj, assay.use = res_cols, group.by.vars = split_col)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindClusters(merged_seu_obj, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
  
  return(merged_seu_obj)
}
```

## Run Pipeline
```{r chunk-05}
seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed <- multi_sample_pipeline(seu_obj_short_term_immune_2024_02_09, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA")

# Add ribo genes just in case
ribo_genes_mouse <- grep("^Rpl|^Rps", rownames(seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed), value = TRUE)
seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed, features = ribo_genes_mouse)

# View UMAP
DimPlot(seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")
```

## Add Previous Annotations for comparison
```{r chunk-06}
# Prior annotations, joined on barcode. Load-bearing, not just a comparison.
#
# This column was extracted once from
#   2024-08-06-Immune-Finalized-Seurat-Object.RDS (21,523 cells)
# which lived under another user's Minerva account. The whole object was 4.5 GB and only
# this one column was ever read from it, so it is stored here as a CSV instead: the join
# below is unchanged, and this notebook now runs without cluster access.
meta_immune_old <- read.csv("../data/prior_annotations_immune_2024-08-06.csv",
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  select(barcodes, final_clusters)

seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed@meta.data <- seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcodes") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_immune_old, by = "barcodes") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("barcodes")
```


```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
DimPlot(seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed, group.by = "final_clusters", label = T)
saveRDS(seu_obj_short_term_immune_combined_processed, "../outputs/short-term_immune-shor-term-2024-02-09.RDS")
```
